description_en: Queries the details of the remediation setting crr-f381cf0c1c2f004e****
description_zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询修正设置crr-f381cf0c1c2f004e****的详情
name: DescribeRemediation

parameters.help_en: The rule ID. You must specify at least one of ConfigRuleId and RemediationId to identify an existing remediation setting
parameters.help_zh: 规则 ID。ConfigRuleId 与 RemediationId 至少提供一个能定位到已存在修正设置的有效标识符
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the remediation setting. You can call the ListRemediations operation to obtain the ID. If no remediation setting is created, call the ListConfigRules operation to query rules, call the ListRemediationTemplates operation to query compatible templates by filtering based on ManagedRuleIdentifier, call the CreateRemediation operation to create a remediation setting, and then call the DescribeRemediation operation to query the remediation setting. You must specify at least one of ConfigRuleId and RemediationId to identify an existing remediation setting
parameters.help_zh: 修正设置 ID，可通过 ListRemediations 获取。若尚未创建修正设置，推荐依次调用 ListConfigRules 获取规则、ListRemediationTemplates（按 ManagedRuleIdentifier 过滤）获取兼容模板、CreateRemediation 创建修正设置，再调用 DescribeRemediation 查询。ConfigRuleId 与 RemediationId 至少提供一个有效标识符
parameters.name: remediation_id

Remediation.description_en: The details of the remediation setting

InvokeType.description_en:
The execution method of the remediation. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: Not executed.

AUTO_EXECUTION: Automatic execution.

MANUAL_EXECUTION: Manual execution.

NOT_CONFIG: Not configured
InvokeType.description_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：

NON_EXECUTION：不执行。

AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。

MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。

NOT_CONFIG：未设置

LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_en: The ID of the last successful remediation execution record
LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的记录ID

LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last successful remediation execution. Unit: milliseconds
LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的时间戳。单位：毫秒

LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_en:
The invocation type of the last successful remediation execution. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: Not executed.

AUTO_EXECUTION: Automatic execution.

MANUAL_EXECUTION: Manual execution.

NOT_CONFIG: Not configured
LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_zh:
修正最近一次执行成功的方式。取值：

NON_EXECUTION：不执行。

AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。

MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。

NOT_CONFIG：未设置

RemediationId.description_en: The ID of the remediation setting

RemediationOriginParams.description_en: The conversion format of the remediation setting parameters. This parameter is used only to convert the parameters of an Operation Orchestration Service (OOS) template
RemediationOriginParams.description_zh: 修正设置参数的转换格式。仅用于转换OOS模板的参数

RemediationSourceType.description_en:
The source of the template used to execute the remediation. Valid values:

ALIYUN: Official template.

CUSTOM: Custom template.

NONE: None
RemediationSourceType.description_zh:
执行修正的模板来源。取值：

ALIYUN：官网模板。

CUSTOM：自定义模板。

NONE：无

RemediationTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the remediation template

RemediationType.description_en:
The remediation type. Valid values:

OOS: Operation Orchestration Service (OOS), which indicates official remediation.

FC: Function Compute (FC), which indicates custom remediation
RemediationType.description_zh:
修正类型。取值：

OOS：运维编排（官方修正）。

FC：函数计算（自定义修正）
